original_query: Add formal verification assertions to the design using ChiselFV or Chisel LTL. Place assertions directly inside the original DUT module/class emitted by VerilogGenerator, not in a separate *Formal wrapper or sibling module. Focus on key properties like safety and liveness.

arguments.reason: Read the full design source to understand the tree arbiter structure, signals, and which module VerilogGenerator emits.

files.content:
1: package llmverify
2: 
3: import chisel3._
4: import chisel3.util._
5: 
6: // Phase enumeration for the arbiter states
7: object Phase {
8:   val idle :: request :: lock :: release :: Nil = Enum(4)
9: }
10: 
11: /*
12:  * A process loops through four states: idle, request, lock, and release.
13:  * The transitions from idle to request, and from lock to release are
14:  * nondeterministic.
15:  */
16: class Proc extends Module {
17:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
18:     val ack = Input(Bool())
19:     val req = Output(UInt(2.W)) // 2 bits to represent 4 states
20:   })
21:   
22:   // For nondeterministic choice, we'll use a random signal
23:   // In real hardware, this could be tied to a pseudo-random generator
24:   val choice = Wire(Bool())
25:   choice := RegNext(RegNext(0.U) ^ RegNext(1.U)) // Simple pseudo-random
26:   
27:   val reqReg = RegInit(Phase.idle)
28:   
29:   when(reqReg === Phase.idle && choice === 1.U) {
30:     reqReg := Phase.request
31:   }.elsewhen(reqReg === Phase.request && io.ack === 1.U) {
32:     reqReg := Phase.lock
33:   }.elsewhen(reqReg === Phase.lock && choice === 1.U) {
34:     reqReg := Phase.release
35:   }.elsewhen(reqReg === Phase.release) {
36:     reqReg := Phase.idle
37:   }
38:   
39:   io.req := reqReg
40: }
41: 
42: /*
43:  * The arbiter cell has two inputs from children and two outputs to children.
44:  * One input from parent, and one output to parent. The latch holdToken
45:  * corresponds to whether the cell holds the token. The latch prevLeft
46:  * is used to keep track of which way the token went last,
47:  * to impart fairness in the scheduling of the children.
48:  */
49: class ArbitCell extends Module {
50:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
51:     val clk = Input(Clock())
52:     val topCell = Input(Bool())
53:     val urLeft = Input(UInt(2.W))
54:     val urRight = Input(UInt(2.W))
55:     val uaLeft = Output(Bool())
56:     val uaRight = Output(Bool())
57:     val xr = Output(UInt(2.W))
58:     val xa = Input(Bool())
59:   })
60:   
61:   val prevLeft = RegInit(0.B)
62:   val processedLeft = RegInit(0.B)
63:   val processedRight = RegInit(0.B)
64:   val holdToken = RegInit(io.topCell)
65:   
66:   // essentially a macro for checking if must release the token to parent
67:   val mustGiveParent = (processedLeft || io.urLeft =/= Phase.request) &&
68:                        (processedRight || io.urRight =/= Phase.request) &&
69:                        !io.topCell
70:   
71:   // essentially a macro for checking if a descendant owns the token
72:   val childOwns = io.urLeft === Phase.lock || io.urRight === Phase.lock
73:   
74:   // essentially a macro for checking if a child is being given the token
75:   val giveChild = Wire(Bool())
76:   
77:   /*
78:    * Condition under which the token is given to the left child
79:    * Must own token, have request from left, and either no request from
80:    * right or if there is a request from the right it should be left's
81:    * turn (since right went the last time )
82:    */
83:   io.uaLeft := !mustGiveParent && holdToken && io.urLeft === Phase.request &&
84:                (io.urRight =/= Phase.request || !prevLeft)
85:   
86:   /*
87:    * same as above for right
88:    */
89:   io.uaRight := !mustGiveParent && holdToken && io.urRight === Phase.request &&
90:                 (io.urLeft =/= Phase.request || prevLeft)
91:   
92:   giveChild := io.uaLeft || io.uaRight
93:   
94:   val requesting = io.urLeft === Phase.request || io.urRight === Phase.request
95:   
96:   /*
97:    * signal to parent:
98:    *
99:    *   1. request if don't own the token,
100:    *   2. lock if descendant has locked the token
101:    *   3. release if child has released token
102:    *   4. idle otherwise
103:    */
104:   io.xr := Mux(!holdToken && requesting, Phase.request,
105:            Mux(childOwns, Phase.lock,
106:            Mux(holdToken && !io.topCell && (mustGiveParent || !requesting), Phase.release,
107:                Phase.idle)))
108:   
109:   when(io.xa) {
110:     holdToken := 1.B
111:     processedLeft := 0.B
112:     processedRight := 0.B
113:   }.elsewhen(giveChild) {
114:     holdToken := 0.B
115:   }.elsewhen(io.urLeft === Phase.release || io.urRight === Phase.release) {
116:     holdToken := 1.B
117:   }.elsewhen(io.xr === Phase.release) {
118:     holdToken := 0.B
119:   }
120:   
121:   /*
122:    * keep track of which child got the token last
123:    */
124:   when(io.uaLeft) {
125:     prevLeft := 1.B
126:   }.elsewhen(io.uaRight) {
127:     prevLeft := 0.B
128:   }
129:   
130:   /*
131:    * child has finished processing the token
132:    */
133:   when(io.urLeft === Phase.release) {
134:     processedLeft := 1.B
135:   }.elsewhen(io.urRight === Phase.release) {
136:     processedRight := 1.B
137:   }
138: }
139: 
140: /*
141:  * The inteconnections between the processors and the cells.
142:  */
143: class TreeArb4 extends Module {
144:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
145:     val clk = Input(Clock())
146:     // Add outputs to preserve internal signals
147:     val p0_req = Output(UInt(2.W))
148:     val p1_req = Output(UInt(2.W))
149:     val p2_req = Output(UInt(2.W))
150:     val p3_req = Output(UInt(2.W))
151:     val xr_root = Output(UInt(2.W))
152:   })
153:   
154:   // Level 0 cells and processors
155:   val C0_0 = Module(new ArbitCell())
156:   val C0_1 = Module(new ArbitCell())
157:   val P0 = Module(new Proc())
158:   val P1 = Module(new Proc())
159:   val P2 = Module(new Proc())
160:   val P3 = Module(new Proc())
161:   
162:   // Level 1 cell
163:   val C1_0 = Module(new ArbitCell())
164:   
165:   // Connect level 0
166:   C0_0.io.clk := io.clk
167:   C0_0.io.topCell := 0.B
168:   C0_0.io.urLeft := P0.io.req
169:   C0_0.io.urRight := P1.io.req
170:   P0.io.ack := C0_0.io.uaLeft
171:   P1.io.ack := C0_0.io.uaRight
172:   
173:   C0_1.io.clk := io.clk
174:   C0_1.io.topCell := 0.B
175:   C0_1.io.urLeft := P2.io.req
176:   C0_1.io.urRight := P3.io.req
177:   P2.io.ack := C0_1.io.uaLeft
178:   P3.io.ack := C0_1.io.uaRight
179:   
180:   // Connect level 1
181:   C1_0.io.clk := io.clk
182:   C1_0.io.topCell := 1.B
183:   C1_0.io.urLeft := C0_0.io.xr
184:   C1_0.io.urRight := C0_1.io.xr
185:   C0_0.io.xa := C1_0.io.uaLeft
186:   C0_1.io.xa := C1_0.io.uaRight
187:   
188:   // Root cell doesn't have parent, so xa is tied to 0
189:   C1_0.io.xa := 0.B
190:   
191:   // Connect outputs for observation
192:   io.p0_req := P0.io.req
193:   io.p1_req := P1.io.req
194:   io.p2_req := P2.io.req
195:   io.p3_req := P3.io.req
196:   io.xr_root := C1_0.io.xr
197: }
198: 
199: object VerilogGenerator extends App {
200:   emitVerilog(new TreeArb4(), args)
201: }
